title: Error
description: Problem Details error object, based on RFC 7807.

type.description: A URI identifying the error category. See docs/errors.md for the full catalog.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the error.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

instance.description: URI reference identifying the specific occurrence, typically the task_id.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code for programmatic handling.
